TransPerfect Life Sciences offers services during each step of your patient’s clinical trial
journey. From recruiting participants to retaining patients, our team takes care of all your
content needs so you can focus on your mission—to save lives.

A global diagnostics manufacturer came to us with a problem. They were late in identifying a pattern in their complaint
data because adverse event reports, clustered in three European markets, had all the right signals but were buried
across languages, formats, and disconnected systems. They were adding staff and investing in tools but still struggled
to harness all the intelligence needed to stay ahead of regulatory requirements.

texts.text: This is the gap where patient safety meets operational reality.

Medical device manufacturers face an unprecedented convergence of pressures: Rigorous post-market surveillance
requirements, evolving expectations around real-world evidence, and the fundamental challenge of monitoring device
performance across dozens of markets and languages.

TransPerfect Medical Device exists at this intersection, combining our ISO 13485, 14971, 9001, 18587, and 17100
certiﬁed quality and risk management systems with AI-enabled workﬂows and technology development to reduce
compliance costs through automation without sacriﬁcing quality. We’re a technical, tactical execution partner with the
expertise to transform your global clinical and regulatory data into a competitive advantage across your existing
platforms and repositories. We focus on the organization, connectivity, traceability, and actioning of global content
that scales your team’s productivity with quality instead of risk.
